incidents.name: Starlink transfer business-logic flaw
incidents.notes: The Starlink token's transfer logic moves tokens out of the liquidity pair's own balance without a sync(), so the attacker collapsed the reserve and swapped a small holding out for the pair's WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: Starlink 0x518281F34dbf5B76e6cdd3908a6972E8EC49e345 created 2022-02-22T13:21:20Z by 0xe2a8b3bc543a6412865cc9179a08409d18ef8694, unrelated to attack sender 0x187473cf30e2186f8fb0feda1fd21bad9aa177ca; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 38.3598 WBNB left the pair 0x425444dA1410940CFdfB6A980Bd16aA7a5376d6D; 38.3598 WBNB x $307.85 at incidentTimestamp 1676587683 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $11,809.
